entities.summary: Iliya Markov, known as Ilyo Voyvoda or Dedo Iljo Maleshevski, was a Bulgarian revolutionary and hajduk from the region of Macedonia. He was the father-in-law of revolutionary Dimitar Popgeorgiev (1840-1907).
